preconditions.description: The number of main courses k and the total number of courses n must satisfy the given bounds.

preconditions.expression: len(main_courses) == k and all(1 <= course <= n for course in main_courses)
preconditions.description: The main courses list must contain exactly k distinct integers within the range [1, n].
The total number of dependencies across all courses must not exceed 100,000.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' if not possible_to_pass else True
postconditions.description: If it is not possible to pass all main courses, the output must be '-1'.

postconditions.expression: len(output_courses) == m and all(1 <= course <= n for course in output_courses)
postconditions.description: The output must contain m distinct integers representing the courses to be passed in chronological order.

postconditions.expression: all(course in output_courses for course in main_courses)
postconditions.description: All main courses must be included in the output courses.
